# Tri-peaks solitaire: Soar agent from the Rosie teaching script

**Runnable.** `tri-peaks.soar` loads the shared library (`Soar/soar-library`, v2.42) and `tri-peaks-rules.soar` (17 task rules, generated by `gen.py` from the statements in `english-input.txt`; `tools/rosie_solitaire.py`). Generated 18 Nov 2026. Needs Soar 9.6.6 (or the PyPI soar-sml bindings).

## Run

    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . tri-peaks.soar --seed 1 --cap 60000
    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . tri-peaks.soar --json | python3 ../../tools/check_moves.py tri-peaks init-tri-peaks.world

`python3 gen.py WORLD` writes the same rules with another example state as the initial world.

## Results (library v2.42, 18 Nov 2026)

Example states (`gen.py WORLD`, `run_agent.py --check`): init-tri-peaks: goal false, failure false; final-tri-peaks: goal true, failure false; second-tri-peaks: goal false, failure false.

Seeds 1-3, cap 60,000 decisions; plans replayed independently by `check_moves.py` (legality from the action statements, the losing conditions, the goal).

| Seed | Outcome | Decisions | Actions | Replay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | success | 606 | 9 | goal holds |
| 2 | success | 737 | 9 | goal holds |
| 3 | success | 646 | 9 | goal holds |

## Translation

- Operator move (argument1 = the block, argument2 = the garbage or the top block): statement 4 (a free block onto the
  clear garbage) and statements 8 and 10 (a free block onto the top block when its value is one less or one more).
- free (statement 6: clear and no position) and top (statement 9: clear and position one) are expanded in place. The
  blocks start with ^position 0, read as "absent" (A-P3); a block moved onto the garbage pile gets ^position 1, so it is
  top while clear and trashed (statement 16). A block's position is read as that of the pile it is in: 1 when it is on the
  garbage or on a block that is (so the example states, which give no position to the blocks, come out as intended).
- clear is a maintained one-argument relation (statement 5). A block can lie on two blocks (tri-peaks), so the block it
  leaves becomes clear only when no other block is on it (a negated condition in the applications; A-P4).
- The goal (statement 15) is expanded over the blocks of the world file. "The solution has nine steps" (statement 11)
  is checked against the plans, not used.
Propose initialize-tri-peaks when its conditions below hold.

The assumption codes (A-S, A-G, A-C, A-P) are explained in `tools/rosie_solitaire.py` and `../../PILOT.md`.
